newsitem.title: MEXICO: LatAm beverage analyst Laura Ehrlich joins Salomon.
newsitem.headline: LatAm beverage analyst Laura Ehrlich joins Salomon.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Wednesday it had named Latin American beverage analyst Laura Meizler Ehrlich as a vice president in the company's Latin American equity research group in New York.
Ehrlich worked previously at Paribas Capital Markets, where she was a beverage analyst. Prior to that, she was a vice president at Oppenheimer & Co.

Salomon Brothers also announced the appointment of Rodolfo de Angele as a research analyst at Banco Patrimonio, the firm's Brazilian affiliate, where he will focus on the steel, gas and petrochemical sectors. In the steel sector, he will work closely with Mauricio Reveco, the senior analyst for Latin American steel and mining, Salomon Brothers said.
De Angele previously worked as an equity analyst at Banco Votorantim.
